title: feat(metadata-protocol): one effective read serves the .custom declared override; the env-wide list and export agree; a withdrawn public form stays withdrawn
body:
domain:server#4 · os-zhuang · session_01QUs3BtyH9zgxKzYrJiH18J

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-zhuang"} -->
_Requested by **Sam** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01LjZwNRFiG2fkp8SNf6rHNx?thread=cmsg_01LjZwNRFiG2fkp8SNf6rHNxEBem1ofL4XeqCYDUtUe69E)_
Fixes #28409

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: follow-up #28509

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:装好的包(如 HotCRM)的某一项,如果在它配对的 `.custom` 包里有声明了 `overrides` 的同名项,现在不指定包的读取、指定 HotCRM 的读取、三层视图、按包或全环境的列表都返回这份定制;导出时 `.custom` 包带着定制和声明,HotCRM 自己的导出保持原样。全环境列表里,别的依赖包的同名项不再挤掉 HotCRM 的那一项。
- 为什么改:之前五个读取口径各说各话,声明了定制也没有任何读取用它(ADR-0146 D8,史诗 #28236 的 N-10)。
- 风险与回滚:公开表单在列表收窄后仍按「收窄前的列表」判断是否已撤下,撤下的表单不会重新开放(只会更严)。依赖包同名项从全环境列表消失、三层视图里多出孤儿项展示,都是可见变化。无数据迁移、无接口形状变化,回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`(`servedOverlayRowCandidates` 的定制位、`readFlattenedMetaItems` 末尾的列表收窄、`getMetaItemLayered` 的孤儿段)、`packages/rest/src/form-routes.ts`(`resolveFormBySlug` 的撤下判断)、`packages/metadata-protocol/src/served-override.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/protocol-custom-override-effective-read.test.ts`(先构建 metadata-protocol),预期 11 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**One predicate (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/served-override.ts`, new export).** `isServedOverrideRowOf(row, basePackageId)` is the one spelling of "is this stored row the served override of X's name". The row must be bound to X's pair by its own `package_id` (`isCustomizationPairOf` from N-08, never a body stamp), of an overridable type (`isOverridableMetadataType`, with the type folded to its singular), and its body must declare `overrides.package = X`. `basedOn` is not judged. Every read below asks it, and N-11, N-15 and N-16 are meant to consume it. There is no second copy.

**The by-name reads and the layered read (`protocol.ts`).** `servedOverlayRowCandidates` takes a `servedOverride` flag. With it, the places for package X are `X.custom` (as the override of X), then X, then the unbound row. A pair row fills the first place only when the predicate holds. An undeclared pair row is skipped there and stays the pair's own item. Every read that serves X's name passes the flag: the active by-name read, its draft preview, `getMetaItemLayered`, and the list merges. A read that answers a write's address (the strict draft read, the view-container expansion's package order) does not pass it, so a save naming X still writes X's own partition. The served override is stamped `_packageId: X`.

**The env-wide list (`readFlattenedMetaItems`).**
- The scoped list for X reads the pair's rows as override stand-ins, so `GET /api/v1/meta/:type?package=X` serves the override in X's slot.
- The unscoped list then narrows: for a name exactly one code package ships, an item bound to a different package is dropped.
- Kept: unbound items, names nobody ships, names several packages ship (ADR-0048 §3.3), and the `package` type.
- `shippingPackageIds` / `soleShippingPackage` in `protocol-environment-rows.ts` read the shippers the same way `packagelessContentPackage` does.

**The per-package layer.** `getMetaItemsPerPackage(request)` is a new public method. It is the same flattened read without the override and without the narrowing, which is the list as it stood before this PR: one item per package that holds a name, each package's own document. It has two readers:
- `GET /packages/:id/export` (`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`, feature-detected) reads it. The base's export therefore carries the base unchanged, and the pair's export carries the overriding item with `overrides` (the export's `clean` drops only `_`-prefixed keys).
- The form doors (below).

**Public forms (`packages/rest/src/form-routes.ts`), the hard requirement.**
- `resolveFormBySlug` offers the candidates of the effective list.
- It judges each candidate's withdrawal (`anonymousFormIntakeWithdrawnIn`) against the effective list beside `getMetaItemsPerPackage`, a layer that is never narrower than the list it judged before.
- A dependent package's withdrawing row of the base's form still closes it, although the effective list no longer holds that row.
- A form offered only by a body the effective read no longer serves is not offered. That direction only narrows.

**Orphans (`getMetaItemLayered`).** Some rows of X's name are no longer served under X's address:
- a row in X's pair without the declaration;
- a row in a package whose dependency closure holds X.

When nothing else is the overlay, the layered read reports such a row in `overlay` with `effective` = X's code document, the shape #21002 uses for a shadowed flow row. The pair's row is reported first, then rows by package id. The lock flags stay the address's. A row of a package outside X's closure is not reported.

**No `packages/spec` change.** `getMetaItemsPerPackage` is a server-only extension. It is typed on the runtime domain's protocol slice and feature-detected in rest. Orphans use the existing `overlay` field. No request or response schema moves.

## Tests

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/served-override.test.ts` (new, 6 cases). The predicate's table: accepted rows, the binding (another package's declaration, the base itself, another base's pair), a body stamp on an unbound row, a declaration that does not name the base, the non-overridable types, and total-function inputs.
- `packages/objectql/src/protocol-custom-override-effective-read.test.ts` (new, 11 cases, real protocol over real `ObjectQL`, packages installed through the package door, rows written through the draft save and per-item publish):
  - **AGREEMENT:** the five reads for one item. These are the package-less read, `?package=X`, the layered read (scoped and not), the list scoped to X, and the env-wide list. All serve the override's columns under `_packageId: X`.
  - A non-pair declaration is ignored, and an undeclared pair row is the pair's own item.
  - **List:** a dependent's row no longer replaces X's item, while the per-package layer still holds both. The **unbound row still wins** in the list beside a dependent's row. Beside an unbound row, the override is served where `packagelessAddress` sends the save.
  - **Export layer:** the pair carries `overrides`, and X is unchanged.
  - **Orphans:** an undeclared pair row and a dependent's row are each reported in `overlay` with effective = X. The control has no row and no overlay.
  - **Outside the closure:** the row is served under its own address only and not reported as an orphan.
- `packages/rest/src/public-form-withdrawal-effective-read.test.ts` (new, 4 cases). It drives `resolveFormBySlug` through the **real list** (real protocol, real SQL store, base shipped through `registerApp`):
  - Control: the base's form is served.
  - A dependent's withdrawing row closes the form on GET and submit. The premise is asserted: the effective list holds only the public body, and the per-package layer holds both.
  - The override is the form served, and an override that withdraws the form closes it.
  - An override cannot re-open a form the base's own document withdraws.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-export-per-package-layer.test.ts` (new, 3 cases). The export door asks `getMetaItemsPerPackage`, never `getMetaItems`. The pair's export keeps `overrides`. Control: a protocol without the layer is read as before.
- Reconciled existing pins:
  - `protocol.read-verb-canonical-fold.test.ts`: the request-boundary fold population gains `getMetaItemsPerPackage` (seventeen to eighteen).
  - `protocol-packageless-read-dependent-package.test.ts` (#28238): the layered read now reports the dependent's row in `overlay` (Wanted 5) where it asserted `null`. Its header now points here.
  - Four rest harnesses that inject the list now inject the per-package layer beside it: `public-form-file-field`, `public-form-option-subset`, `public-form-required`, `rest-write-route-hook-refusal-sentence.ledger`. They stubbed only `getMetaItems`, and the real per-package read over their unprovisioned store threw, exactly as the real `getMetaItems` does there (measured).
- Kept their meaning, unchanged and green: `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.item-read-overlay-cache.test.ts` and `packages/objectql/src/environment-overlay-five-types.test.ts`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Ordering, a reading the seat can contest: the override wins over an unbound row.** D8 item 1 keeps the unbound row winning "over the code package", and it still does, in the reads and in the list. When both an unbound row and the declared override exist, `packagelessAddress` (unchanged) sends a save naming no package to the pair's row, because it is the only binding. Serving the unbound row there would answer that save with a read it never changes (the #23165 shape). So the override is served, and the pin `beside a package-unbound row, the declared override is served…` records it. N-16's migration moves unbound rows into the pair, which ends the case.
- **The form doors only narrow.** A withdrawal anywhere in the per-package layer closes the name's form in every package, as before (a known limit that fails closed). An override that re-opens a form the base's document withdraws stays closed: the base's document is a body the doors honoured before. Each anonymous form request now reads the list twice (effective and per-package). Measured on the rest harness with one view and the box shared with a gate run: `getMetaItems` 0.33 ms and `getMetaItemsPerPackage` 0.32 ms per call, and `GET /forms/:slug` 0.55 ms. This is not measured on a large environment.
- **Visible list change.** The env-wide list no longer shows a dependent package's same-named item beside the base's item for a name exactly one code package ships. That item is still served under its own address (`?package=`). A name two or more code packages ship is not narrowed.
- **"X's app" read.** ADR-0146 D8 spells this as the base app's rendering (the read naming no package) and the export of X's app surface. Both are pinned above.
- **Not here:** the write gate (N-09), flows and actions (N-11): `declinesStoredRow` still declines a stored flow body over a shipped flow name before the predicate is asked. Also out: N-15, N-16, N-17, N-19.
- Diff size: 1475 changed lines (+1415 / −60), under the 3000-line stop.
